issue: Visible quote renewal cleared the fee, quote-ID renewal invalidated unchanged discounts, review raced an in-flight request and quote expiry forced customers to restart confirmation.
changes: Keep last fee while renewing the same branch/address; invalidate on actual destination/account change
Coalesce concurrent quote requests and await freshness when reviewing or applying discounts
Bind discount UI validation to cart/address/fee rather than ephemeral quote ID
Remove routine refresh/status banners and one-second screen rebuilding
Revalidate an expired commercial review internally and preserve one idempotency key; ask again when monetary breakdown changes
Preserve durable pending-attempt recovery and guard repeated taps
